achDetails.description: ACH-specific details for the transfer. Present when transfer was processed via ACH network.

source.description: Information sent to the source/originating bank account along with the transfer

addenda.description: Contains addenda information for the transfer

values.description: An array containing a single string addenda value

beneficiaryName.description: Beneficiary of the transaction's name. In general, should match the user onboarded to the Platform's name

companyEntryDescription.description: Describes the purpose of the transaction

effectiveDate.description: The date when the ACH transaction becomes effective, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. This is typically the settlement date for the transaction

postingData.description: Suggested memo line format for bank statements, structured as companyName:companyDiscretionaryData:beneficiaryName

routingNumber.description: Routing number of Originating Depository Financial Institution (ODFI). Identifies the financial institution that originated the ACH transaction

traceId.description: A unique identifier for tracing the ACH transaction through the banking network. Used for transaction tracking and reconciliation purposes

destination.description: Information sent to the destination/receiving bank account along with the transfer

rtpDetails.description: Real-Time Payments (RTP) network specific details. Present when transfer was processed via RTP network.

destination.description: RTP destination details with network identifiers

remittanceData.description: Remittance information included in the transfer request

networkId.description: Unique identifier for the transfer within the RTP network

endToEndReferenceId.description: End-to-end reference identifier for the RTP transfer

fedNowDetails.description: FedNow Service network specific details. Present when transfer was processed via FedNow network.

destination.description: FedNow destination details with network identifiers

remittanceData.description: Remittance information included in the transfer request

networkId.description: Unique identifier for the transfer within the FedNow network

endToEndReferenceId.description: End-to-end reference identifier for the FedNow transfer

destination.description: The payment network used to process the transfer
